measurement_software.scope: Measured with working-tree source, not a later clean commit. All seven archived measured Python files match the manifest hashes.

dataset.scope: Identical checksum-pinned raw Parquet and taxi zones, copied once into isolated inputs. Source months, not pickup-date filtering. Zero downloaded bytes in every replay.

serverless.hardware_capacity: Managed by Databricks; not exposed or matched to classic.

configuration.cache_policy: Uncontrolled. Fresh Databricks job cluster IDs do not guarantee fresh underlying Azure VMs. Node timeline records map classic_1 and classic_2 to the same pair of Azure VM instance IDs.
configuration.scope: Deployment-configuration comparison, not identical hardware/runtime stacks. Prepare and final audit use Performance Optimized serverless outside the six measurements. Production and frozen tables are not replay destinations.

timing_scope: Job duration is Jobs API end_time minus start_time; no client polling time. Task timers have API granularity and setup is not all scheduling/environment overhead. Pipeline-call time includes final operational writes; internal processing time ends before those writes. Keep these timers separate.

correctness.scope: Exact Bronze/Silver/quarantine row multisets excluding per-run provenance. Exact Gold keys, counts and decimal metrics; floating aggregates use absolute 1e-9 plus relative 1e-9 tolerance. Frozen Q1 versions unchanged.

azure_actual_cost.resource_scope: Workspace managed resource group, November 6 UTC, grouped by resource ID and service.
azure_actual_cost.scope: An initially throttled request succeeded after cooldown. Empty cost results are missing billing evidence, not zero VM/disk cost.

azure_reference_evidence.sampled_storage: classic_3: each of two VMs had one 64-GiB P6 and one 128-GiB P10 Premium_LRS managed disk. Active resource ClusterId tags matched the recorded job cluster.
azure_reference_evidence.scope: Retail VM rate is a reference, not an observed bill or a complete VM/disk estimate. Earlier samples' disk capacities are not inferred from the third sample.

billing.per_sample_infrastructure_attribution: The first two classic clusters reused the same VM instance IDs. Resource/day Azure cost aggregates cannot be counted separately for both runs; retain shared costs once and label any future allocation or amortization explicitly. Node timeline minute records are not complete Azure allocated lifetimes.
billing.scope: Initial collection snapshot: exact job/run IDs were queried, with prepare/audit separate, but no DBU records had arrived. See latest_refresh for subsequent observed DBU and Azure infrastructure accounting. Historical null totals and pending IDs describe this initial snapshot, not the latest collection. Original measurement report unchanged.

billing_refresh_20261106_b.scope: Observed signed DBU records priced at effective USD list prices, provisional rather than invoices. All six measured runs have priced records; prepare/audit excluded. The 38.27% reduction compares median Databricks charges only, not total cloud cost. Serverless infrastructure is included in its SKU, but classic Azure VM/disk charges remain uncollected. Original measurement and earlier billing collection bytes are unchanged.

cloud_cost_closeout_20261106_c.scope: Effective USD list-price DBU estimates plus observed Azure pre-tax resource costs. All four recorded VM IDs and eight disks have cost rows, including explicit zero-cost root-disk rows. Matching public IP and VM bandwidth charges are included. Shared VM resources across classic_1/classic_2 counted once. Compare totals across three measured replays per configuration, or amortized means, not median per-run infrastructure bills. Serverless infrastructure is included in its SKU. Shared workspace storage, ADLS storage, collector, prepare/audit, taxes and invoice-level adjustments are excluded. These are provisional attributable compute/infrastructure costs, not invoices or total project spending. Late audit DBU records changed its excluded cost; measured DBU costs were unchanged.

interpretation.decision: Keep Standard serverless for this workload on observed latency and attributable compute/infrastructure cost. Production already uses it; no newly realized production savings are claimed.
interpretation.limitations: Three trials per configuration on Q1 data. Runtime versions and hardware capacity differ, caches are uncontrolled, Azure VM reuse occurred, and classic setup varied substantially. Not a matched-hardware, concurrency, scaling, or general price-performance result. Combined cost compares three-replay totals or amortized means, not per-run infrastructure medians. Shared storage and invoice-level adjustments are excluded; observed costs remain provisional.
